Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Breakfast: Option 3: Oats porridge (60 g) with nuts
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + veg (100 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2) + chicken curry (120 g) + salad
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) + mixed veg

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS focus on fiber-rich whole grains and regular protein.
Limit high-sugar and processed foods to manage insulin.
Include gentle exercise like walking and yoga.
Prefer structured meal timing to avoid binge eating.
